columns.comment: Product key PRD-<NAME> (upper-case name, non-alphanumerics as '-'), e.g. PRD-IMPORT-LC.
columns.name: product_id

columns.comment: Product name as used by the source systems (unique), e.g. Import LC, Revolving Credit Facility.
columns.name: product_name

columns.comment: Product family: Corporate Lending, Structured Lending, Cash, Liquidity, Payments, Trade Finance, Supply Chain Finance, FX, Rates or Sustainable Finance.
columns.name: product_family

columns.comment: Business line - Lending, Transaction Banking, Markets or Sustainable Finance.
columns.name: business_line

columns.comment: Core product (booked in a product system) or CRM sales product (a coverage / sales bundle used in opportunities, NBP and signals).
columns.name: product_type

columns.comment: True for exposure-bearing products (loans, trade finance instruments, SCF financing, sustainable loans).
columns.name: is_credit_product

columns.comment: True for deposit / account products (current, savings, time deposit, money market, investment, correspondent accounts).
columns.name: is_deposit_product

columns.comment: True for Transaction Banking products (cash, liquidity, payments, trade finance, SCF).
columns.name: is_tb_product

columns.comment: True for sustainable-finance products (green and sustainability-linked loans).
columns.name: is_sustainable

comment: SMBC APAC product hierarchy: business line > product family > product (Lending: Corporate / Structured Lending; Transaction Banking: Cash, Liquidity, Payments, Trade Finance, Supply Chain Finance; Markets: FX, Rates; Sustainable Finance), plus the CRM sales products used in opportunities, next-best-product scores and signals (e.g. Cash Management Mandate, Trade Finance Line). Facts carrying a product name join on product_name to get product_id. Grain: one row per product.
